span.div:
Gossip exchanges begin between partitions:
Node 2 sends digest to Node 5.
Node 5 receives: "Node 4 is dead?"
Node 5 responds: "Node 4 is alive, inc 7!"
Node 2 merges: Node 4 status = Alive.
In the next round, Node 2 gossips to Node 1
and Node 3, correcting their state.
Within ~5 rounds, all 6 nodes converge.
